key_insight: ProIQA assesses math item quality by combining problem-stem understanding with the step-by-step reasoning process, enabling finer-grained evaluation than stem-only methods.
engineering_relevance: It provides a scalable framework for automated quality control of generated math items in intelligent tutoring and educational content pipelines.
method: Formulates item quality across knowledge concepts, difficulty, and disciplinary competencies in a process-aware way.
Builds structured reasoning trees from raw solutions using LLMs.
Encodes tree structure with GNNs and fuses it with stem semantics in a dual-view "Stem + Solving" model.
evidence_signal: Experiments on K12 math datasets show the framework captures process-oriented features and supports comprehensive assessment across learning objectives.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of LLM-generated reasoning trees, which may introduce errors or inconsistency in the process representation.
paper_title: ProIQA: A Process-Based Framework for Fine-Grained Math Item Quality Assessment
